{{Top|leg}}
An '''antitoxin patch''' was an adhesive patch that was worn in the skin near the [[Stomach/Legends|stomach]]. It provided a low dosage on antitoxin, which helped the wearer defend against ingested and airborne poisons. It lasted twenty-four [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] and cost twenty-five [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
